A '''shielded circuit multiplexer''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] component. It was part of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter's]] primary [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]<ref name="SWS" /> and weapons targeting package.<ref name="RPG" /> It relayed data from the primary sensors to the [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]].<ref name="SWS" />
